steps.text: Stir together 1 teaspoon salt, 1/4 teaspoon black pepper, and cayenne pepper in a small bowl until well combined; rub evenly into chicken breasts.

Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat; cook chicken in hot oil until no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, 5 to 7 minutes per side. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).
Stir together onion, avocado, and lime juice in a medium bowl until combined; season with salt and pepper. Spoon over chicken breasts to serve.

raw_recipe.headline: Spicy Avocado Chicken
raw_recipe.description: A simple sauce of red onion, avocado, and lime juice is served over pan-fried chicken breasts for a spicy main course that comes together quickly.

video.description: Pan-fried chicken topped with a fresh avocado and red onion salsa.

review.reviewBody: This is a keeper! Lots of flavor and very low effort. Decrease amount of cayenne if you want a little less heat. Next time, I am going to try this on some fish, and I will try squeezing a little lime on the meat (possibly marinate in lime for 10 minutes or so) before I pat on the salt/pepper rub. Thanks for contributing this, it's going in our rotation! **UPDATE** I tried this recipe on tilapia and now make this all the time, only with fish, not the chicken. Go easy on the spice layer on the fish, saute/pan fry over medium to med-hi heat for 3-4 minutes each side, until fish turns to solidly white. For the salsa, I REDUCE the lime and onion to about 2 tsp of lime juice (1/2 a juicy lime) and 1/2 a small-medium red onion, chopped fine. Yum!
We bbq'd the seasoned chicken instead of frying it, and I only had white onion on hand so made the salsa from that. So easy and delicious!

I would have given this dish 5 stars but I made two big changes that I think added to the flavor. I agree with some other reviews that the ratio of avocado and onion seemed wrong. I had way too much onion for the garnish, and had to scoop about 1 cup of it out to have a better ratio. Next time I will increase the amount of avocado or decrease the amount of onion. The second big change was adding bacon. My husband and I first thought the picture on this recipe had bacon in it...and then decided that sounded great! So we cooked about five pieces of bacon and broke it up into little pieces, added it to the garnish and served. We also decided to grill the chicken (to save some time), which turned out awesome!! It added a perfect amount of salt to compliment the spice. Great dish and I will make this again!

This recipe is great, quick, cheap, and nutritious. I used a lemon because I rarely have lime and it still tasted amazing. One half avocado and one half lemon juice, and about half a tablespoon of raw onion (I had white on hand). Just season the chicken and cook with a little olive oil. Perfect! I was worried about my cayenne burning but it made such a nice crisp! Yum. But becareful! I'm sure if I let it go any longer it may have burned. 

One tip, cut the breast in half! It'll cook more evenly and less guess work. :)

This was excellent! I made it with two changes. I added some chipotle cheese on top of the chicken for the last 2 minutes or so and because some reviewers mentioned that the red onion was overpowering, I sauteed it first til it was nice and soft, let it cool and then added it to the avocado and lime juice. I served it with salsa and sour cream.

A great week night meal, quick, tasty and easy to prepare. The chicken took longer than 5 minutes per side. I cooked mine in a cast iron skillet and finished it in the oven (350 for 10 minutes). The avocado cream sauce had way to much onion. . I would suggest using half of a red onion.

I went ahead and tried the recipe as is despite thinking the ratios were wrong. I make guacomole all the time and use 3-4 avocados to 1 onion. I love onions, but one onion to one avocado was just way too much. I would also suggest adding a clove or two of minced garlic and a little cilantro for some more flavor. When it comes to spiciness, I have a qualm with dishes that have the word "spicy" in them when they aren't really that spicy. Some extra cayenne and diced jalepeno peppers add a nice kick.

Total winner! I added sliced garlic to the pan when I stir fried the chicken (in my wok). It was delicious. For the avocado I used lemon juice instead of lime, tiny diced garlic instead of onion and added 1 tsp of superfruit balsamic vinaigrette. I served it on the side of wild rice with sautéed veggies. My fussy 13 year old devoured them both.

We enjoyed this, although I made several changes. I grilled my chicken rather than frying it and I added garlic powder and onion powder. For the avocado part, I left out the onion but added some lemon juice and salsa and just made it into guacamole. Fabulous flavor!

Made this tonight. Basically followed the recipe. Used the rub on the chicken. It was not spicy but had a nice flavor. I baked it in the oven with olive oil instead of on the stovetop. Used green onion instead of red. Served it over sautéed spinach. My husband and I really enjoyed this tasty meal. A bonus is that it was very easy!

Used green onion instead of red. Served it over sautéed spinach. My husband and I really enjoyed this tasty meal. A bonus is that it was very easy!

So simple, with few ingredients, but packed with flavor. This recipe actually surprised me at how good it was with such basic ingredients. The creamy avocado really balances out the heat from the cayenne. Everyone loved it and I'll be keeping this in my regular rotation.
Super easy and delicious. I mash my Avocado and add diced tomatoes to it and it's sooooooo good.
Loved it—added sliced cherry tomatoes :)
We love making this. So quick & easy!!!

I can’t do spicy, so I left out the cayenne. Still super tasty! My husband says it’s the best thing I’ve ever made. I didn’t have any cilantro on hand, but I would add it next time. I’m not much of a cook, so to have something so easy turn out so delicious was awesome!
Incredibly easy to make and my family loved it!

I used all of the ingredients in the recipe but I did not put in as much onion or hot pepper. Everyone I’m the house loved this recipe. It was flavorful and creamy. Making something creamy in a dairy free house is very unique. I loved how simple and quick it was to make. I highly recommend this dinner for a working mother during a very busy week.
Loved this. I did add tomato and bacon bits and used yellow onion. I spooned it over roasted butter and herb chicken. Will be making this again.

Boyfriend thought this was wonderful... i however thought the chicken was bland with just the basic seasonings on it. will make again but this time add some onion powder/cumin or maybe just some more salt. A solid 4 star meal for me!
